name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5_Clinical-Trials_Matryoshka
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (nomic_bert: BERT + rotary, GLU MLP)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Sentence-transformers fine-tune of nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 on vab46's Clinical_trials_anchor-positive-pairs_EmbeddingModel-data (7,193 training pairs), 4 epochs, batch 4, Matryoshka training across 768/512/256/128/64 dimensions. Recorded at the native 768 dim. NOT a duplicate of the existing nomic-embed-text-v1-5-clinical-trials-matryoshka2 record: that one trains on the ...data2 corpus (7,869 pairs, a different generation of the same dataset), and each card re-runs the base on its OWN corpus, so the two baselines disagree sharply (accuracy@1 768d base 0.169 vs 0.315 here) and the records are not cross-comparable. Rows recorded x100 from the card's 0-1 values. Base values are the author's own re-run on that corpus, not nomic's published MTEB figures. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-19.
